newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Corp, others to repair Uzbekistan airports.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Corp, others to repair Uzbekistan airports.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp said on Tuesday that it, Mitsui & Co Ltd and Shimizu Corp have received a 7.3 billion yen order to repair three airports in Uzbekistan.
The contract is to repair runways and buildings as well as to modernise equipment in control towers.
The airports are in Samarkand, Bukhara and Urgench.
The repairs are expected to start at the end of January and be completed in August.
The project will be financed by the Japanese government's yen-denominated aid to the Central Asian state, a Mitsubishi spokesman said.
